rules.rule: shipments.shipped_date IS NULL OR shipments.shipped_date <= CURRENT_DATE
rules.description: Shipped date must not be in the future.

impact.reason: Future dispatch dates break logistics scheduling.

rules.rule: shipments.delivered_date IS NULL OR (shipments.shipped_date IS NOT NULL AND shipments.delivered_date >= shipments.shipped_date)
rules.description: Delivered date cannot precede shipped date.

impact.reason: Delivery before shipment is logically impossible.

rules.rule: shipments.delivered_date IS NULL OR shipments.delivered_date <= CURRENT_DATE
rules.description: Delivered date must not be in the future.

impact.reason: Future delivery dates indicate data timing errors.

rules.rule: shipments.shipment_status <> 'DELIVERED' OR shipments.delivered_date IS NOT NULL
rules.description: If status is DELIVERED, a delivery date must be present.

impact.reason: Missing delivery date for delivered shipments obscures order completion.

rules.description: A delivery date implies the status must be DELIVERED.

impact.reason: Inconsistent status misleads downstream tracking and reporting.
